DECISroN TO ASSIGN COUNSEL TO CHARLES GHANKA Y TAYLOR
THE PRINCIPAL DEFENDER
CONSIDERING the Statute of the Residual Special Court for Sierra Leone and in particular
Article23 thereof;
CONSIDERING the Rulesof Procedureand Evidenceasadopted bythe plenary ofJudgesof
the Residual Special Court as amended on the 16th December2021;
CONSIDERING the Directive on the Assignment of Counsel as adopted by the Registrar on
the 15t October 2003 and in particular Article 13 thereof;
CONSLDERING that Mr. Charles Ghankay Taylor a Special Court for Sierra Leone Convict
is presently serving his jail term at HM Prison Frankland, Durham in the United Kingdom
pursuant to an Order of the Special Court for Sierra Leone dated 4th October 2013;
CONSIDERING that Charles Ghankay Taylor has informed the Principal Defender of the
Residual Special Court tor Sierra Leone of his desire to appoint Counsel of his choice to his
legal team namely; Dr. Courtenay Griffiths KC from the United Kingdom;
CONSIDERING that Dr. Courtenay Griffiths KC has consented to represent Mr. Charles
GhankayTaylor pro bonobyvirtue ofanagreementbetweenMr.Taylor and thewithin named
Counsel to which the Residual Special Court for Sierra Leone is not a party;
RESIDUAL SPECIAL COURT FOR SIERRA LEONE
RECEIVED
COURT MANAGEMENT
THE HAGUE

12840
CONSIDERING that the Principal Defender of the Residual Special Court may assign
Counsel intheinterestofjustice,torepresentaConvict;
HEREBY DIRECTS the assignment of Dr. Courtenay Griffiths KC as Counsel to Mr.
CharlesGhankayTaylor whichtakeseffectonthedateofthis Decision.
Done at Freetown this 31 day of August, 2023
